method: Searched the web for each site (a fetch of the sites themselves fails from the builder's network), so features come from search results, vendor pages and third-party reviews; paid tiers and limits change often, confirm before any price claim.

features.name: Merge PDFs
features.detail: Combine several PDFs into one, drag to reorder files before joining.
features.verse_evidence: Merge tab: files in order with up/down, pages like 1-3 per file; /pdf/merge/ is the merge-only page

features.name: Split by range, every N pages, or extract
features.detail: Cut a PDF into several by page ranges, fixed counts, bookmarks or size; extract chosen pages.
features.verse_evidence: Split tab: by ranges (1-3;4-6), every N pages, one file per page, with a ZIP

features.name: Delete pages
features.detail: Pick pages to remove from a PDF and save the rest.
features.verse_evidence: Extract or delete pages tab: keep or delete pages like 1-3, 7, last, even, odd

features.name: Reorder pages with thumbnails
features.detail: Drag page thumbnails into a new order, add blank pages, from several files.
features.verse_evidence: Pages tab: thumbnails of every page of several files; drag, Alt+arrows, buttons; rotate, delete, reverse, save

features.name: Rotate pages
features.detail: Turn one page, a selection or all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
features.verse_evidence: Rotate tab (all or named pages) and the turn button on each thumbnail

features.name: Compress PDF
features.detail: Shrink a file by recompressing images and structure; levels from light to strong.
features.verse_evidence: Compress tab: lossless tidy, or pages redrawn as JPEG pictures at three strengths (text stops being selectable; said on the page)

features.name: Images to PDF
features.detail: JPG, PNG and more into one PDF, with page size, orientation and margins.
features.verse_evidence: Images to PDF: JPG, PNG and anything the browser can show, page size, direction, margin

features.name: PDF to images
features.detail: Every page saved as JPG or PNG.
features.verse_evidence: PDF to images: PNG or JPG at 72, 150 or 300 dpi, a ZIP

features.name: Convert to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint
features.detail: Office files to PDF and back; done on a server.
features.verse_evidence: skipped: Word, Excel and PowerPoint conversion needs a server; nothing leaves the device here

features.detail: Add text, draw shapes, insert images and annotations on pages.
features.verse_evidence: skipped: adding text, shapes and annotations is not built yet; a PDF holds no paragraphs to edit

features.name: Sign PDF
features.detail: Draw, type or upload a signature and place it on the page; request signatures from others.
features.verse_evidence: not built yet: draw a signature and place it on a page (next)

features.name: Watermark
features.detail: Stamp text or an image across all pages, with opacity and position.
features.verse_evidence: text watermark with opacity, size, angle and pages; no image watermark

features.name: Page numbers
features.detail: Number pages, choose position, first number and format.
features.verse_evidence: Page numbers tab: position, style (1 / 1 of 10 / Page 1), first number, skip the first page

features.detail: Encrypt a PDF with a password or remove a known password.

features.detail: Recover a damaged PDF as far as it can be read.
features.verse_evidence: not built: pdf-lib refuses a damaged file; no recovery
